instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. Inside an unfinished concrete building, the woman in the yellow safety vest and yellow hard hat (R2) stands on the left in profile, facing right. On the right, the woman in the orange safety vest and white hard hat (R1) stands in profile, facing left. They shake right hands, with R2's thumb resting visibly on top of R1's hand. Both women maintain eye contact and smile warmly. The background consists of a concrete wall and a glass door. Natural light fills the space, emphasizing the vibrant orange and yellow vests.
